widgets_values:
混合限制‌：
所有素材（图 + 视频 + 音频）混合输入时，总数不得超过‌12 个‌！！
参考图像最多只能接入9张图像，如果不接入就用开关关掉

支持最多‌3 段音频‌（需与图像或视频搭配，总时长不超 15 秒），用于设置节奏、对白或环境声。
支持最多‌3 段视频‌（每段 2-15 秒，总时长不超过 15 秒），用于定义运镜风格或动作逻辑。

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young woman in <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, and <Picture 3>: a slim East Asian woman in her early twenties with fair skin and soft rosy blush, dark almond eyes, a black wool beret worn tilted over a low bun with wispy side-swept bangs, a thin silver double-chain necklace with a small oval pendant, a greyish-taupe high-neck cap-sleeve knit top, and black high-waisted studded shorts with a wide black belt.
<Subject 2> is the young man in <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, and <Picture 3>: a lean East Asian man in his mid-twenties with short neat black hair swept to one side, thin rectangular metal-rimmed glasses, a black leather zip-up jacket over a dark brown crew-neck tee, and black trousers.
<Subject 3> is the café interior shared by <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, and <Picture 3>: a warm specialty coffee shop with a tan leather banquette along the wall, small wooden tables, brass pendant lamps with warm bulbs, potted green plants, and a tall window with soft overcast daylight and a blurred street outside.
<Picture 1> is the first frame of [Shot 1]: <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> seated on opposite sides of a small wooden café table, both turned toward the camera and smiling, each holding a latte.
<Picture 2> is the first frame of [Shot 2]: the same table seen from a forty-five-degree side angle, <Subject 1> on the leather banquette holding her cup, <Subject 2> leaning in with his hands clasped on the tabletop.
<Picture 3> is the first frame of [Shot 3]: a closer profile two-shot of the same table, <Subject 1> facing right with her cup, <Subject 2> facing left with his hands clasped, a slice of cake between them.

summary:
[keyframe completion] The target video is a ten-second three-shot scene of <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> on a first blind date in <Subject 3>. <Picture 1> anchors the opening frame as both look up at the camera for a photo taken by an off-screen friend; <Picture 2> anchors the second shot as they settle into conversation; <Picture 3> anchors the third shot as the exchange turns warm and she agrees to a second meeting. All three frames keep the two characters' faces, hairstyles, and outfits identical.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - her face, black beret over a low bun, side-swept bangs, silver pendant necklace, greyish-taupe high-neck top, and black studded shorts remain identical across all shots.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - his face, swept black hair, thin metal-rimmed glasses, black leather jacket, and dark brown crew-neck tee remain identical across all shots.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the tan leather banquette, wooden tables, brass pendant lamps, plants, and window light are retained.
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] first frame): fully_preserved - the composition, tabletop props, and both characters' poses at the opening moment are reproduced exactly.
<Picture 2> ([Shot 2] first frame): fully_preserved - the forty-five-degree side viewpoint, seating order, and hand positions are reproduced exactly.
<Picture 3> ([Shot 3] first frame): fully_preserved - the closer profile framing, the cake on the table, and both seated postures are reproduced exactly.

detailed_description:
The target video is photorealistic live-action with warm natural café lighting, shallow depth of field, and a candid documentary-romance feel.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> sit across a small wooden table in <Subject 3>, both already turned toward the lens. She holds her latte with both hands near her chin, her forearms resting above the table edge; he holds his cup raised at chest height, his glasses catching the light from the window. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. Both straighten slightly and lift their gaze fully to the camera, their shoulders relaxing. An off-screen friend's voice (S1), a light casual young female voice close to the microphone, says, <d>[Chinese] 看我这边，笑一个。</d> A single shutter click follows, and both break into natural smiles at the same moment; she tilts her head a fraction to her right, he lifts his cup a little higher as if toasting the photo.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to <Picture 2>, the same table from a forty-five-degree side angle. <Subject 1> lowers her cup to the table and rests one hand around it, her back against the tan leather banquette. <Subject 2> leans forward, both hands loosely clasped on the tabletop, his gaze staying on her face. The camera holds a static shot. <Subject 2> (S2), a warm low young male voice at a relaxed conversational pace, asks, <d>[Chinese] 你平时周末都做什么？</d> She lowers her eyes briefly, a small reserved smile forming, then looks back up and answers in a soft, quiet young female voice (S3), <d>[Chinese] 在家待着比较多。</d>
[Shot 3] At 00:06.800, the shot cuts to <Picture 3>, a closer profile two-shot across the table with the slice of cake in the lower foreground. <Subject 2> (S2) keeps his hands clasped and tilts his head slightly toward her, his tone brightening, and says, <d>[Chinese] 那下次我带你去爬山。</d> <Subject 1> (S3) turns her face a little further toward him, the shy smile widening, and replies, <d>[Chinese] 好啊。</d> The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed and settles on her faint smile as her fingers tighten once around the cup handle.

overall_soundscape:
Low café room tone with a faint espresso-machine hiss and the soft clink of cups on saucers continues throughout. A single camera shutter click lands right after the opening line, followed by the quiet creak of the leather banquette and the light scrape of a cup being set down on wood.

non_diegetic_music:
A gentle acoustic-guitar figure at a slow tempo with sparse upright-bass notes, entering softly under the second shot and thinning to a single sustained guitar note at the end.
